verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿ ਬਖਸੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: satigur gunee nidhaan hai gun kar bakhasai avaguniaare|

en.bdb: The true Guru is the store house of virtues who out of his benevolence blesses even the wicked ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਹੈ ਪੰਜੇ ਰੋਗ ਅਸਾਧ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: satigur pooraa vaidh hai pa(n)je rog asaadh nivaare|

en.bdb: The true Guru is a perfect physician who cures all the five chronic ailments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੁਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਸੁਖ ਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਦੁਖਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sukh saagar gurudheau hai sukh dhe mel le dhukhiaare|

en.bdb: Guru is ocean of pleasures who happily absorbs in him the sufferers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੋਖੀ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur pooraa niravair hai ni(n)dhak dhokhee bemukh taare|

en.bdb: The perfect Guru is away form enmity and He liberates even the slanderers, envious ones and the apostates.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਸਦਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਜਮ ਡਰੈ ਉਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur pooraa nirabhau sadhaa janam maran jam ddarai utaare|

en.bdb: The perfect Guru is fearless who always dispels the fear of transmigration and Yama, the god of death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਵਡੇ ਅਜਾਣ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: satigur purakh sujaan hai vadde ajaan mugadh nisataare|

en.bdb: The true Guru is that enlightened one who saves ignorant fools and even the unknown ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੂ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਅੰਧਲੇ ਉਧਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: satigur aagoo jaaneeaai baeh pakaR a(n)dhale udhaare|

en.bdb: The true Guru is known as such a leader who catching hold from the arm takes the blind also across (the world ocean).
I am sacrifice unto that true Guru who is the pride of the humble ones
